reasons: The only exclusivity covenant (Section 5.8) binds Harpoon and its Affiliates — the licensor/counterparty side — and expressly benefits AbbVie, our client as licensee/option holder; per the rule, restrictions binding the vendor are acceptable.

Section 7.1.2 corroborates that exclusivity obligations apply only 'in the case of Harpoon,' and no reciprocal 'AbbVie shall not develop/commercialize' or field-of-use covenant is cited or apparent; Field/Territory language in the license grants is grant scope, not a restrictive covenant on our business.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed, and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs; the deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') also passes.
Rationale is accurate and correctly states the preferred position is met, so no negotiation issue should be raised.
